botcomponent.description: Resolve people from the standard Dataverse systemuser table. Use it to turn a GUID from _faf001_assignedto_value, _faf001_executedby_value, _faf001_initiatedby_value, or _faf001_generatedby_value into a person, and to turn an email address or name supplied by the user into a systemuserid. Filter with systemuserid eq <guid>, internalemailaddress eq '<email>', or contains(fullname,'<text>'). Useful columns: systemuserid, fullname, internalemailaddress, domainname, jobtitle, isdisabled, _businessunitid_value. Always pass $select and $top; never list the whole table.
botcomponent.name: List user rows
